summary: Integrality outside T and the congruence at T together give the congruence of x − 1 modulo u, entry by entry.

steps.claim: If x is integral then u⁻¹(x − 1) is integral outside T (u⁻¹ integral outside T).
Compare entrywise the conditions (Ô is integral at all places: outside T by integralOff, at T by O).
steps.lean: simp [unitaryLevel, mem_intGL, IsIntMatrix, mem_Ô_iff T, Units.smul_def, forall_and] at i ⊢; tauto
